Captures the healthy pre-restart state and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered system/LVM/mount/data state. Post-restart verification reports system state running, zero failed units, active 2.44 GiB LV, mounted 2.542 GB filesystem, and the original checksum/content.

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/data-loop-lvm >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
image=/var/lib/data-lvm.img
case "${1:-start}" in
  start)
    if ! /usr/sbin/losetup -j "$image" | grep -q .; then
      /usr/sbin/losetup --find --show "$image"
    fi
    /usr/bin/udevadm settle
    /usr/sbin/vgchange -ay data_vg
    ;;
  stop)
    /usr/sbin/vgchange -an data_vg || true
    loopdev=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -j "$image" | sed -n 's/:.*//p' | head -n 1)
    if [ -n "$loopdev" ]; then
      /usr/sbin/losetup -d "$loopdev"
    fi
    ;;
  *) exit 2 ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
sudo -n chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/data-loop-lvm
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/data-loop-lvm.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop-backed LVM storage for /srv/data
Wants=systemd-udev-settle.service
After=systemd-udev-settle.service
Before=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/data-loop-lvm start
ExecStop=/usr/local/sbin/data-loop-lvm stop
TimeoutSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
if ! grep -q '^UUID=33566cdc-b1c1-458e-a13e-a7f1a735c4b2[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab; then
  printf '%s\n' 'UUID=33566cdc-b1c1-458e-a13e-a7f1a735c4b2 /srv/data ext4 defaults,x-systemd.requires=data-loop-lvm.service,x-systemd.after=data-loop-lvm.service 0 2' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
fi
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable data-loop-lvm.service
sudo -n systemctl start data-loop-lvm.service
sudo -n systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/data-loop-lvm.service
sudo -n mount -a
printf 'UNIT='; systemctl is-enabled data-loop-lvm.service; systemctl is-active data-loop-lvm.service
printf 'FSTAB_ENTRY='; grep '^UUID=33566cdc-b1c1-458e-a13e-a7f1a735c4b2[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab
printf 'MOUNT='; findmnt -no SOURCE,TARGET,FSTYPE /srv/data
